Episode 20. After giving a clear Biblical outline in the previous 3 episodes as to what constitutes Babylon, who teaches the serpent theology and who has been identified as the great anti-power against Jesus Christ, we now look at the final conflict that the world is heading for, the likes of which we have never seen before.
